launch_commands.backend: cd '{RepoWsl}' && mkdir -p services/launcher/state/logs && setsid -f .venv_dashboard/bin/python scripts/dashboard_api.py > '{BackendLogWsl}' 2>&1 < /dev/null && echo backend_started
launch_commands.frontend: cd '{UiWsl}' && VITE_SPINETOP_API_BASE=/api setsid -f npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --strictPort --port {FrontendPort} > '{FrontendLogWsl}' 2>&1 < /dev/null && echo frontend_started
